rows.jp: 部室には誰もいない。
rows.en: No one was in the clubroom.

ghs.en: There is nobody in the club room.

rows.jp: 遊んでいる時は手狭な部屋も、無人だと閑散として見える。
rows.en: The room always felt cramped when we were fooling around in it. Empty, it looked desolate.

ghs.en: A room that feels cramped in times of playfulness has the dullness of an off-season when deserted.

rows.jp: 廊下側の窓一面に張り出してあるカムフラージュが、ぺろりとはがれていた。
rows.en: The camouflage pasted across the entire corridor-side window had come loose and curled away.

ghs.en: On one surface of the corridor-side window, the camouflage was peeling off, leaning inward like a sticked-out tongue.

rows.jp: これは無人の室内写真を、横長に印刷して丹念に貼り合わたものだ。
rows.en: It was a panoramic photograph of the empty room, carefully printed and pieced together.

ghs.en: Photographs of the room interior, deserted, printed landscape and affixed with diligence.

rows.jp: ガラス一枚隔てると、意外とわからないものである。
rows.en: Through a single pane of glass, it was surprisingly hard to tell.

ghs.en: It's something unexpectedly impossible to understand what can be segregated by a single pane of glass.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: いつもここでたむろってた。
rows.en: We used to hang out here all the time.

ghs.en: We were always gathering here.

rows.jp: 友貴がよく座って漫画を読んで。
rows.en: Tomoki would sit there reading manga.

ghs.en: Tomoki always sitting reading a manga.

rows.jp: 桜庭もいた。
rows.en: Sakuraba was here too.

ghs.en: Sakuraba was here too,

rows.jp: 先輩も。
rows.en: Misato too.

ghs.en: and Senpai as well.

rows.jp: ここは美希と霧の定位置。
rows.en: This was Miki and Kiri’s usual spot.

ghs.en: This was a fixed home spot for Miki and Kiri.

rows.jp: みゆきは……あのあとすぐにＸ組に移動になってしまったんだっけ。
rows.en: Miyuki… She had been transferred to Class X right after that, hadn’t she?

ghs.en: Miyuki... as I recall, she ended up being transferred to Class X quickly after that.

rows.jp: 容態が悪化して。
rows.en: Her condition had worsened.

ghs.en: Her conditions had deteriorated.

rows.jp: Ｘ組は他のクラスとは違う。
rows.en: Class X was different from the other classes.

ghs.en: Class X is different from the other classes.

rows.jp: 群青の終着駅だ。
rows.en: It was the end of the line at Gunjo Academy.

ghs.en: It is the final destination for an ultramarine of Gunjou.
ghs.assessment: The source name is presented in a nonstandard long-vowel spelling. Standard Hepburn requires: Gunjou -> Gunjō.
ghs.remedy: Apply the listed standard-Hepburn spelling while preserving the surrounding sentence.

highlights.text: It is the final destination for an ultramarine of Gunjou.

rows.jp: もっとも幸福なクラスでもあるわけだが。
rows.en: Though it was also the happiest class.

ghs.en: But it is yet the happiest of all classes.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: 人の心は、まるで予測もできない。
rows.en: The human heart was impossible to predict.

ghs.en: The human heart, the human mind, they seem impossible to completely predict.

rows.jp: まったく普通だったのに、ある日突然……。
rows.en: Someone could seem completely ordinary, and then one day, without warning…

ghs.en: It's all so damnably normal, but then one day, all of a sudden...

rows.jp: 人類の種としての限界だという者もいた。
rows.en: Some called it the limit of humanity as a species.

ghs.en: There are those who are said to exist at the limits of the human species.

rows.jp: 俺はそうは思わない。
rows.en: I did not agree.

ghs.en: I do not believe that.

rows.jp: ……病だ。
rows.en: …It was an illness.

ghs.en: ...it's a disease.

rows.jp: 人は人と接さなくなり、メディアによって心の渇きを癒す。
rows.en: People stopped engaging with one another and let media soothe the thirst in their hearts.

ghs.en: When direct contact with people vanishes, people heal the thirst of their hearts via the media.

rows.jp: まともな食事をとらず有害な化学物質ばかりを口にするようなものだったのだ。
rows.en: It was like refusing proper meals and putting nothing but harmful chemicals into their bodies.

ghs.en: It's as if they never have a proper meal, and instead put nothing in their mouth but harmful chemical substances.

rows.jp: ……歪んでしまった。
rows.en: …We had grown warped.

ghs.en: ...a complete distortion.

rows.jp: その結果が……これだ。
rows.en: And this… was the result.

ghs.en: And the result is... this thing here.

rows.jp: 重度不適合者隔離施設・群青学院―――
rows.en: Gunjo Academy, an isolation facility for the severely maladapted—

ghs.en:
Gunjou Institute
Isolation Facility
for the Severely Non-compliant
ghs.assessment: The source name is presented in a nonstandard long-vowel spelling. Standard Hepburn requires: Gunjou -> Gunjō.
ghs.remedy: Apply the listed standard-Hepburn spelling while preserving the surrounding sentence.

highlights.text:
Gunjou Institute
Isolation Facility
for the Severely Non-compliant

rows.jp: 幸せな学生たちと、屈強な警備員と、セラピストや精神科医の常駐する……原発による過当利益緩和政策の一環として導入された特殊教育施設。
rows.en: A special-education facility populated by happy students and strapping security guards, with therapists and psychiatrists in permanent residence… established as part of a policy to offset excess profits from the nuclear power plant.

ghs.en: Happy students, and burly guards, and permanently stationed therapists and psychiatrists... it was one point of the Policy for the Mitigation of Excessive Profits from the Nuclear Plant to introduce this special education facility.

rows.jp: 自然の中で心を癒す。
rows.en: Heal the heart in nature.

ghs.en: "To Heal the Heart in the Heart of Nature."

rows.jp: 表向きのキャッチコピーだ。
rows.en: That was the slogan for public consumption.

ghs.en: That's the official slogan pasted large-font on the advertisement.

rows.jp: けど誰もが知っている。
rows.en: But everyone knew.

ghs.en: But, and everybody knows,

rows.jp: 適応係数の低い者を癒す手段はただ一つ。
rows.en: There was only one way to heal someone with a low adaptation coefficient.

rows.jp: 人との有益な接触。
rows.en: Beneficial contact with other people.

ghs.en: beneficial contact with people.

rows.jp: すなわち。
rows.en: That is to say—

ghs.en: In other words,

rows.jp: 触れあいでしかないのである。
rows.en: Human connection. Nothing else.

ghs.en: there is nothing to be had but reciprocal touches.

rows.jp: けれど怯える教師や警備員がその相手になりえるだろうか。
rows.en: But could frightened teachers and security guards provide that connection?

ghs.en: Would frightened teachers and guards become partners in that, however?

rows.jp: なるわけがない。
rows.en: Of course they could not.

ghs.en: There's no way they would.

rows.jp: 傷ついた少年少女同士で、心をわけあうしかないのだった。
rows.en: The wounded boys and girls had no choice but to share what was in their hearts with one another.

ghs.en: There is no choice but for the wounded boys and girls to share hearts and minds with each other.

rows.jp: 「太一？」
rows.en: “Taichi?”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Taichi?"

rows.jp: 友貴がやってきた。
rows.en: Tomoki had arrived.

ghs.en: Tomoki had come about.

rows.jp: 「よ、シスコン」
rows.en: “Hey, sister-obsessed.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hoy, Siscon."

rows.jp: むっとする。
rows.en: He bristled.

ghs.en: He gets in a huff.

rows.jp: 「……今はもう違う」
rows.en: “…Not anymore.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "...not anymore now."

rows.jp: 「だっけ？」
rows.en: “Oh, right?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Seriously?"

rows.jp: 不適合者は、傾向として他者に敵意や恐怖を抱きやすい。
rows.en: The maladapted tended to feel either hostility or fear toward other people.

ghs.en: The non-compliant have a tendency to easily embrace hostility or terror for other people.

rows.jp: 前者なら危険人物、後者であれば可哀相な子。
rows.en: The former made you dangerous; the latter, a poor child.

ghs.en: The former are dangerous characters, the latter pitiable children.

rows.jp: 「……太一も来てたんだな」
rows.en: “…You came too, huh.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "...so you came 'round too, Taichi."

rows.jp: 「んー、まあな。状況知りたかったし」
rows.en: “Mm, yeah. I wanted to know what was going on.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hmmm, seems so. Wanted to know how things were going."

rows.jp: 「そっちは？」
rows.en: “What about you?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You?"

rows.jp: 「同じ」
rows.en: “Same.”

rows.jp: 「授業がないからさ、すぐやることなくなった」
rows.en: “Without classes, I ran out of things to do right away.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "There's no classes, 'course, so I got nothing urgent to do."

rows.jp: 「例の新しい部活は？　食料調達部だっけ？」
rows.en: “What about that new club? The Food Procurement Club, was it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And that new club you talked about before? The Food Procurement club was it?"

rows.jp: 「生命維持活動部」
rows.en: “Life-Support Activities Club.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Life Maintenance and Improvement Club."

rows.jp: 「変な名前」
rows.en: “Weird name.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Weird name."

rows.jp: 「名前なんてどうでもいいよ」
rows.en: “The name doesn’t matter.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "The name's just whatever, ya know."

rows.jp: 日曜の夜、状況を確認した俺たちは、まず食料のことを考えた。
rows.en: On Sunday night, after taking stock of the situation, we turned first to the question of food.

ghs.en: On Sunday night, on ascertaining the situation, we first of all thought about food.

rows.jp: そこで友貴が、市内に残ってる食料を回収して健全にわけようということを提案した。
rows.en: Tomoki proposed collecting the food left around the city and dividing it up fairly.

ghs.en: There, Tomoki suggested gathering the food remaining in the city, and distributing it level-headedly.

rows.jp: 俺も名のりをあげたが、拒否された。
rows.en: I volunteered too, but they turned me down.

ghs.en: I submitted myself for it, but I was rejected,

rows.jp: つまみ食いは御法度らしいからだ。
rows.en: Apparently, snacking on the job was strictly forbidden.

ghs.en: as foodsnatching seems to be strictly forbidden.

rows.jp: 「常人の数倍も食べるヤツに任せられる仕事じゃないよ」
rows.en: “This isn’t a job for someone who eats several times as much as a normal person.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Not a job that can be left to a guy that eats several times what normal people do!"

rows.jp: 「食っとらんと言うのに」
rows.en: “I told you, I didn’t eat it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But I donn'do that, I told you."

rows.jp: あれは遊紗ママが勝手に……。
rows.en: That was Mama Yusa acting on her own…

ghs.en: That was a liberty Yusa's mom took...

rows.jp: 「とりあえず、ここが落ち着くんだよね」
rows.en: “Anyway, this place helps me relax.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "For now, here seems it's all calm."

rows.jp: 定位置に座って、地図を広げる。
rows.en: He sat in his usual spot and spread out a map.

ghs.en: Sitting in his home position, he spreads a map.

rows.jp: 町内地図。
rows.en: A map of the town.

ghs.en: It's a map of the town.

rows.jp: 赤ペンで、印をつけていく。
rows.en: He began marking it in red pen.

ghs.en: He goes to draw marks with a red pen.

rows.jp: 「ここは乾物ばかりだから保留と……ここの生ものは……」
rows.en: “This place is all dry goods, so leave it for now… The perishables here…”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Here there's only dried foods, so it's on the back burner... here there's perishables so..."

rows.jp: ぶつぶつ呟きつつ、地図とにらみ合う。
rows.en: He muttered to himself as he studied the map.

ghs.en: Mumbling and muttering while he stares sharp at the map.

rows.jp: その姿が一瞬、漫画を読んでいた友貴と重なった。
rows.en: For an instant, his figure overlapped with the Tomoki who used to sit there reading manga.

ghs.en: And his shape, for an instant, overlapped with that of the Tomoki that read manga.

rows.en: “...Haha.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...hahah."

rows.jp: 「ん？　なに？」
rows.en: “Hm? What?”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Hm? What?"

rows.jp: 「いや」
rows.en: “No.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Nah."

rows.jp: 「なんでもないよ」
rows.en: “It’s nothing.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's nothing."
Tomoki: "?"

rows.jp: 俺はゴムテープを取って、カムフラージュを元通りに直した。
rows.en: I took the duct tape and put the camouflage back the way it had been.

ghs.en: I took some adhesive tape and went to restore the camouflage to order.

rows.jp: 意味のない行動。
rows.en: A pointless gesture.

ghs.en: An action without meaning,

rows.jp: けど友貴は何も言わなかった。
rows.en: But Tomoki did not say anything.

ghs.en: yet Tomoki did not say anything.
